elements.text: Worked example: A coverage tool measures exercised structure; a load generator applies concurrent requests; a defect tracker records anomalies.
Close the notes: Match a testing need to an appropriate tool category.

studyGuide.sectionTitle: FL-6.2.1 · Automation benefits and risks · K1

elements.description: Automation can shorten repetitive work, improve repeatability and accelerate feedback. Adoption, maintenance, training, unrealistic expectations and unsuitable tool choices create costs and risks; tool purchase alone does not ensure success.

elements.text: Worked example: A fast regression suite loses value when flaky checks are ignored; maintenance and result investigation remain necessary.
Close the notes: Recall two potential benefits and two risks of test automation.
Attempt these after studying the chapter, without looking at the keyword table. Explain each answer in your own words, then open the solution.

elements.title: Benefits and risks of test automation
elements.prompt: Classify each as a benefit or a risk of test automation: (1) less repetitive manual work; (2) underestimated maintenance effort; (3) more consistent test execution; (4) relying on the tool when manual testing would be more suitable; (5) faster feedback from shorter execution times.
elements.solution: Benefits: (1), (3) and (5). Risks: (2) and (4). Other risks include unrealistic expectations and dependency on the tool vendor.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which tool best measures how much implemented control flow tests exercise?
practiceQuiz.rationale: Coverage tooling measures exercised structure. The other tools manage anomalies, schedules or specifications.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the objective and apply the decision rule to the facts before comparing alternatives.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A team needs to simulate thousands of concurrent requests. Which tool category fits?
practiceQuiz.rationale: A load tool drives concurrent execution and gathers performance evidence. Static, review and version-diff tools do not supply that workload.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the objective and apply the decision rule to the facts before comparing alternatives.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which is a potential automation benefit?

options.text: Automatic business acceptance of every release

practiceQuiz.rationale: Automation can accelerate repeatable work, but maintenance, investigation and accountable decisions remain necessary.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the objective and apply the decision rule to the facts before comparing alternatives.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which is a realistic automation risk?
practiceQuiz.rationale: Maintenance and adoption costs can undermine expected value. The other options describe potential benefits, not the stated risk.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the objective and apply the decision rule to the facts before comparing alternatives.
